reserveReview.rationale: Independently recomputed under owner ruling D01 from the complete first-party 2026-10-27T16:03:47.000Z balance sheet (Ethereum block 26285121): every asset amount is disclosed in USD and divided by totalAssets USD 102118411.3803. WTGXX's two disclosed holdings (USD 14597867.90 redemption contract + USD 52889724.20 BitGo Trust Account) are aggregated; six resulting weights are rounded independently to eight decimal places and sum to 100 with no invented residual. USDB (Bridge) is no longer listed by the source and its prior 0.00000353% slice is removed, not zero-filled. Existing asset-class and liquidity mappings are preserved; AUSD and USDC identities match the exact Ethereum tokens disclosed by the source. 2026-11-06 complete composition observation: The complete first-party 2026-11-06T18:03:47Z balance sheet (Ethereum block 26357480) publishes totalAssets USD 98313654.0061. Existing adaptFraxBalanceSheet output retains all eight asset records as seven unrounded symbol weights, combining the two WTGXX holdings; source asset rows sum to USD 98313654.00605159, retaining the source rounding difference. USDB is present at USD 3.7 in the primary Solana multisig, mint ENL66PGy8d8j5KNqLtCcg4uidDUac5ibt45wbjH9REzB, and is classified as the issuer-identified Bridge stablecoin. Existing classifications and terms are preserved; no maturity or whole-position liquidity bound is added.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: The issuer's balance sheet identifies WTGXX held in Frax Inc's BitGo Trust Account and cash in a segregated Erebor Bank FBO frxUSD Stablecoin Reserve Account. Other balances are held in on-chain redemption contracts or a Solana multisig, with underlying fund and stablecoin custody outside those contracts. Provider percentages, the BitGo legal entity and account safeguards, portfolio-wide segregation, bankruptcy remoteness, and rehypothecation restrictions are not established by these sources. Named partial custodians do not establish a whole-book institutional tier.
